g.text: 36a · Series episode list discovery and initial playback start
Request series detail & episode list: GET /series/:id/episodes
Forward episode list request to Content Service
Query cached episode list for series ID
Query series metadata and ordered public Reels
Return series data with sorted episode records
Store episode manifest in cache (TTL 10 min)
Return series details with ordered episode list
Render series playlist and begin playing Episode 1
